attempts.text:
**The window starts on the spine at `metG`.** Columns 0 to 1, `metG` and `apbC`, are carried by 92 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, and in a region of plasticity in 2 to 9% of calls. The model names 92 to 97% of them, and hesitates most at `metG`, 0.44 bits.

**Then the graph opens at the fimbrial genes.** Columns 2 to 8 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 83% of calls, and the model names 81 to 96%. Columns 9 to 11 return to the spine, `rcnR` to `thiD`, carried by 90 to 91% of chromosomes, named 89 to 96%. A run of single spine columns follows, `yegW` to `fbaB`, each named in 91 to 94% of calls.

**The first fork is at columns 18 to 24**, in a region of plasticity in 64 to 86% of calls, where the model names 85 to 96%. A second branch of 7 families runs through these columns, carried by 12 to 13% of chromosomes, all shell: `dalD`, `xylB` and [[sugar transport and oxidation]]. The model names the most carried families there in 85 to 96% of calls.

**The long fork and variable stretch runs from column 30 to column 79**, in a region of plasticity in 17 to 89% of calls, named 52 to 92%. Branches of 3 to 7 families cross it, carried by 10 to 12% of chromosomes, all shell, among them [[phage capsid and tail assembly]] and [[phage lysis]]. The `wca` columns 49 to 68, [[colanic acid biosynthesis]], are carried by 63 to 70% of chromosomes.

**The model hesitates most at the end.** Column 72, `rfbA`, 1.39 bits, in a region of plasticity in 80% of calls; column 75, `hisA`, 1.38 bits, 73%; column 73, `rfbC`, 1.36 bits, 77%. Inside a region of plasticity the model names 73% of genes at 0.90 bits, against 90% at 0.30 bits outside. The window ends at column 79, `gndA`, in 30% of chromosomes.

label: metG
facts:
WINDOW: the metG window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor metG, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,596 to 1,675 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying metG once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 82% of genes, 0.61 bits on average (perplexity 2.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 19,825 calls, named 93%, 0.27 bits; shell 20,119 calls, named 81%, 0.63 bits; cloud 3,096 calls, named 14%, 2.61 bits. Outside an RGP 21,240 calls, named 90%, 0.30 bits; inside an RGP 21,800 calls, named 73%, 0.90 bits. Columns: 12 spine, 36 fork, 32 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.90 against 0.30 bits) and names fewer genes (73% against 90%); 21,800 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 72 (rfbA) 1.39 bits, RGP 80%; column 75 (hisA) 1.38 bits, RGP 73%; column 73 (rfbC) 1.36 bits, RGP 77%. The 43 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 77%, 0.73 bits on average; the other 37 columns: named 87%, 0.46 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 18-24 (fork), RGP 64-86%; the least: columns 0-1 (spine), RGP 2-9%.

1. columns 0-1 (2 columns) spine: share 92-100%, all P, RGP 2-9%. Genes: metG, apbC. named 92-97% (mean 94%), fewest named at column 1 (apbC), named 92%; most hesitant at column 0 (metG), 0.44 bits.
